scripts.barrels:lint: (cd src/frontend && npx eslint --fix '**/index.ts') && (cd src/backend && npx eslint --fix '**/index.ts')
scripts.quality: npm run quality:knip && npm run quality:deps && npm run quality:dup
scripts.quality:deps: depcruise src/frontend/app src/frontend/features src/frontend/shared src/frontend/lib --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config src/frontend/tsconfig.json --output-type err-long && depcruise src/backend/common src/backend/modules --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config src/backend/tsconfig.json --output-type err-long
scripts.quality:dup: jscpd src/backend/common src/backend/modules src/frontend/app src/frontend/features src/frontend/shared src/frontend/lib
